design_brief_zh:
本帧为第6/10章：从上一章的箱内干湿衣物分离转到箱外随手物品安置，以“四个侧面挂钩”为主卖点，同时按用户要求展示手机支架与杯架细节。依据为用户明确提供的四个侧面挂钩、可挂多个袋子、拉杆上的可折叠手机支架及可折叠水杯架。下一章单独展开上方金属挂钩，本帧不抢先放大；后续多袋悬挂、杯架专章分别发展使用场景与折叠细节，本帧只做部件位置和用途识别，不重复口号。
PC画布1464×600：slot 0标题位于[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.12]，居中加粗；slot 1支持说明位于[0.14,0.185,0.72,0.09]，居中小字。产品与局部图严格置于[0.12,0.28,0.76,0.39]：中间约[0.39,0.28,0.22,0.39]放银色单箱侧后三分之四视图，以实际挂钩所在侧面朝向镜头，挂一只素色轻便袋示意用途；左侧约[0.12,0.30,0.24,0.34]放拉杆手机支架局部，右侧约[0.64,0.30,0.24,0.34]放杯架展开承托杯子的局部。slot 2位于[0.05,0.72,0.425,0.23]，居中对应左侧手机支架；slot 3位于[0.5,0.72,0.425,0.23]，居中对应右侧杯架。细引线只指向对应支架实体，不指向手机、杯子或留白。阅读顺序为标题、支持说明、中央挂钩用途证据、左手机支架、右杯架。
移动端1200×900单独重排：slot 0与slot 1保留相同比例框；产品区为[0.18,0.29,0.64,0.39]，上部[0.34,0.29,0.32,0.18]展示挂钩侧面裁切，下部左[0.18,0.49,0.29,0.19]展示手机支架、右[0.53,0.49,0.29,0.19]展示杯架。slot 2位于[0.05,0.73,0.43,0.21]、slot 3位于[0.52,0.73,0.43,0.21]，均左对齐。阅读顺序为上到下、细节左到右，不用桌面图直接缩小。
统一使用#F5F3ED浅底、#172B36正文和#01447B贯穿细线，延续全章字体与留白。柔和侧窗自然光，低饱和欧洲现代旅行摄影风格，背景仅保留轻微虚化的候车空间线索。保留银灰竖纹壳面及实际框边，不表现为全铝箱。Arial/Helvetica/Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题、支持说明、细节字号分别约为画布短边的0.066、0.037、0.033，德语预留约20%扩展空间。
证据缺口：现有描述中的图片6、14支持杯架承托用途，图片14支持局部挂袋，但四个侧面挂钩的完整位置及手机支架形状、连接点和折叠机构尚无清晰视觉证据。上线前必须补充当前银色SKU实拍并核对；不得把用途不明的翻片当手机支架，也不得复制挂钩凑足四个。上述坐标为排版方案，不是对缺失结构的确认。没有实拍的部件不可用虚构写实结构充当细节证据。
compliance_note_zh: 四个侧面挂钩及两种可折叠支架来自用户明确提供的产品事实；现有图像不能完整验证挂钩数量及手机支架外形，须补拍核对。仅展示置物用途，不承诺承重、通用手机或杯型适配、防倾倒、行进中稳定性或单手操作。手机、杯子和袋子仅作场景道具，不属于所列包装内容；可在原生A+文本中说明。使用与13A-Sliver-20对应的银色单品素材，不混入其他颜色、竞品品牌、航空公司标识或未核实认证，不暗示套装销售。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ carousel frame for the YWJ 13A suitcase, SKU 13A-Sliver-20. Render NO text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, badges or watermarks. This is chapter six of a continuous product story, transitioning from interior wet/dry organization to exterior item placement. Lead with the side-hook area and show secondary close-up views of the foldable phone holder on the telescopic handle and the foldable cup holder on the shell. Do not feature the upper metal hook as a separate hero; that belongs to the next chapter. Use the verified silver variant, its vertical ribbing, rounded hard-shell profile and actual frame geometry. Do not imply an all-aluminum shell. Use only confirmed product-reference geometry: the supplied written facts specify four side hooks, but their full placement and the phone-holder mechanism require additional exact-SKU reference photography. Never duplicate hooks, reinterpret an unidentified flap as a phone holder, or invent a hinge or attachment. Missing close-up assets must remain unfilled production regions rather than fabricated product evidence. Match the cup-holder appearance to verified reference photography. Show one plain lightweight bag on a confirmed side hook, and an unbranded phone and cup only where confirmed holder geometry allows; these are illustrative props, not included accessories. No motion, load-test graphics or stability claims. Desktop canvas 1464x600: reserve clean empty headline area [0.08,0.05,0.84,0.12] and supporting area [0.14,0.185,0.72,0.09]. Confine all product imagery to [0.12,0.28,0.76,0.39]. Place a side-rear three-quarter suitcase view centrally at approximately [0.39,0.28,0.22,0.39], oriented toward the actual hook-bearing surface; phone-holder close-up left at [0.12,0.30,0.24,0.34], cup-holder close-up right at [0.64,0.30,0.24,0.34]. Reserve empty bottom label cards at [0.05,0.72,0.425,0.23] and [0.5,0.72,0.425,0.23]. For a separate mobile adaptation at 1200x900, retain the top reserved areas, confine imagery to [0.18,0.29,0.64,0.39], place a hook-area crop at [0.34,0.29,0.32,0.18], then phone detail left at [0.18,0.49,0.29,0.19] and cup detail right at [0.53,0.49,0.29,0.19]. Reserve bottom label areas [0.05,0.73,0.43,0.21] and [0.52,0.73,0.43,0.21]. All coordinates are normalized x,y,width,height. Warm off-white #F5F3ED background, restrained #01447B continuity line, soft natural side-window light, low-saturation neutral European travel photography, faint defocused waiting-area context. Keep functional surfaces sharp, shadows realistic, and all reserved copy areas uncluttered. Show repeated detail views as crops of the same single suitcase, never as a multi-suitcase set.
